title: The $23K Annual Bill Every Homebuyer Ignores
hook: The mortgage payment was just the beginning — and that hidden $23,400 annual bill is why 88% of first-time buyers say they were blindsided.
angle: Everyone debates 'rent vs. buy' using only the mortgage — but the real cost of homeownership includes maintenance, taxes, insurance, utilities, and appliances that add up to $23,400/year beyond the mortgage.
audience: Renters considering buying, recent first-time homebuyers feeling the financial squeeze
key_numbers: $23,400/year in hidden costs beyond the mortgage
$700,000 over 30 years never in rent-vs-buy calculators
